summary: Picard Medical filed a Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on July 2, 2026, announcing the availability of a pre-recorded presentation ahead of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders scheduled for July 17, 2026. The filing furnishes a press release and presentation covering business performance, product development, and meeting proposals. No specific deal terms, price, stake, premium, or strategic transaction are disclosed. The filing is a routine shareholder communication and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
